_comment.version: Schema version — increment when fields are added or removed.
_comment.provider_mode: Execution mode for the browser companion. 'browser' = Manifest V3 extension (default). Future: 'headless'.
_comment.accounts: List of Google account email addresses permitted to access notebooks via MCP. Empty = all authenticated accounts.
_comment.notebooks: List of notebook IDs explicitly allowlisted for MCP access. Empty = no notebooks allowed (deny-all default).
